mentions.name: Heidelberg Blocks
mentions.description: A 3D world that started as a 3D bridge and has grown to include multiple German cities, a karting track, a paragliding hill, a flight simulator, and more.
mentions.source_excerpt: My favorite creation is Heidelberg Blocks. What started as a 3d bridge is now a 3d world with multiple German cities, a karting track, a paragliding hill, a flight simulator and much more.
mentions.author: fela
